expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.v===15 && S.r===50 && S.m===1500 && S.pinta==='kuiva' && S.running===false && S.liukuu===0 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: v = 15 m/s, r = 50 m, 1500 kg, dry asphalt, standing on the track (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===2 && R[0].min==='5' && R[0].max==='30' && R[0].step==='1' && R[1].min==='20' && R[1].max==='100' && R[1].step==='5' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two sliders: v 5-30 m/s step 1, r 20-100 m step 5

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===3 && L[0]==='1000,1500,2000' && L[1]==='kuiva,marka,jaa' && L[2]==='0.5,1,2' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: mass, surface, speed

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='m,pinta,r,v' && P.v.unit==='m/s' && P.r.unit==='m' && P.m.unit==='kg' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares v (m/s), r (m), m (kg) and pinta
